title.description: Translated headline in simplified European Portuguese (CEFR B1). Short, declarative, no more than 14 words. Proper nouns preserved.

description.description: Translated meta description in simplified European Portuguese (CEFR B1). One sentence, max 160 characters.

summary.description: Optional 1-2 sentence PT summary used for the dedup index. May be empty.

article.description: Full article body translated into simplified European Portuguese (CEFR B1). Markdown structure preserved (headings, lists, links). Sentence length <= 20 words. Idioms replaced with literal equivalents. Proper nouns preserved (NATO -> OTAN convention applied where standard PT exists).
